verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity documents built-in vesting templates and lets admins build their own custom templates. Employees can track their vesting schedules on their dashboard, which implies the platform computes vested amounts. However, the evidence never mentions cliffs, milestone-based vesting or acceleration on exit, and never shows the admin side automatically tracking vested vs unvested. Missing for 10: explicit cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, admin-side automatic vested/unvested tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
